chunks.text: OpenAI and Cisco want to shield servers before patches arrive. Testing and deploying a patch can take days or weeks, OpenAI says. Cisco's Thomas Graf says some flaws are now exploited before disclosure. Their open-source answer is Shirudo, Japanese for shield. Teams test whether a shield blocks the flaw but lets real requests through. OpenAI says, in a controlled test, a shield stopped Java4Shell without a restart. Would your team let AI agents write shields for your servers?
